card.name: Just before thyroid-related terms
card.fires_on: Small words or spaces right before a thyroid or endocrine term is expected, such as 'syndrome' in Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia, the gap before '2' in MEN 2, or 'and' before 'clinical status of thyroid cancer'.

modes.label: Endocrine neoplasia syndrome
modes.description: The word syndrome or the gap after MEN, in thyroid-cancer contraindication statements.
modes.example: EMPIC tablets are contraindicated in patients with a personal or family history of MTC or in patients with Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia<< syndrome>> type 2 (MEN 2

modes.label: Thyroid cancer dosing
modes.description: The word 'and' in levothyroxine dosing text about thyroid cancer stage.
modes.example: The levothyroxine sodium dosage is based on the target level of TSH suppression for the stage<< and>> clinical status of thyroid cancer.

card.writes: It strongly suppresses thyroid-related word starts such as thy, thyroid and hyp, so it lowers the chance of those words coming next.
card.plain: It fires in thyroid and endocrine-tumor wording and pushes the model away from predicting the word thyroid next.
